comment: The data of tests/test_links.py. cuju lists every path of cuju's repository that the page, the docs, the README and the metadata link to, as it follows https://github.com/AndreKoraleski/cuju/, with its anchor. The test holds each such link to this list, and ci/check_links.py, run by hand, checks the list against cuju's repository on GitHub. skip names the hosts whose addresses are no links to check, and removed the things that the page, the docs and the README no longer mention, each with its reason.

skip.reason: the address of a server on this computer
the address of a server on this computer
the address of a server on this computer
the address a server listens on, which no browser opens
the namespaces of SVG, XHTML and XLink, names rather than links

removed.reason: the promotional montage of Home and its script make_promo were removed
the promotional montage of Home was removed
the music of the montage left with it
the montage, its poster and its teaser left cuju's docs/assets
the map of the sources is the Layout section of CONTRIBUTING.md
ci/make_logo.py draws every icon of the page from the logo
the draft of Brazilian Portuguese is translations/pt-BR/pt-BR.json, and the page ships English alone
the renderer's guide is docs/rendering.md of cuju-render, and cuju's page of that name only introduces the package
